form.label: AD – Group Membership Changes
form.description: Users added to or removed from Active Directory groups — privilege escalation visibility

input.label: 🔍 Global Search Filter
input.placeholder: Filter by user, group, or administrator

div.p: Who added or removed whom from which group — the earliest signal of privilege escalation.

search.query:
`DC-index` (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR source="WinEventLog:Security") EventCode IN (4728, 4729, 4732, 4733, 4746, 4747, 4751, 4752, 4756, 4757, 4761, 4762) | search $search_filter$ | eval ObjectDN = coalesce(DN, TargetObject, ObjectName) | rex field=DN "(?i)cn=(?<GroupName>[^,]+)"
| rex field=Message "(?i)Member\s+:\s+CN=(?<MemberCN>[^,]+)" | rex field=Message "(?i)Member\s+:\s+(?<MemberSID>S-\d-\d+-\d+-\d+-\d+-\d+)" | eval Member = coalesce(Member_Account_Name,Account_Name, MemberCN, MemberSID, "Unknown")
| eval AdminUser = SubjectUserName | eval Computer = ComputerName
| eval Action = case( EventCode IN (4728, 4732, 4746, 4751, 4756, 4761), "Add", EventCode IN (4729, 4733, 4747, 4752, 4757, 4762), "Remove", 1=1, "Modify" )
| eval Group_Type = case( EventCode IN (4728, 4729), "Global Security", EventCode IN (4732, 4733), "Local Security", EventCode IN (4746, 4747), "Local Distribution", EventCode IN (4751, 4752), "Global Distribution", EventCode IN (4756, 4757), "Universal Security", EventCode IN (4761, 4762), "Universal Distribution", 1=1, "Unknown" ) | eval Group_Class = case( EventCode IN (4728, 4729, 4732, 4733, 4756, 4757), "Security", EventCode IN (4746, 4747, 4751, 4752, 4761, 4762), "Distribution", 1=1, "Unknown" ) | eval AdminUser=Subject_Account_Name | eval admin_logonID=Logon_ID | table _time, Computer, AdminUser,admin_logonID, Action, Group_Name, Group_Type, Group_Class, Member,Member_Security_ID, EventCode | sort - _time

format.colorPalette: {"Global Security":#1E88E5, "Local Security":#43A047, "Universal Security":#8E24AA, "Local Distribution":#FB8C00, "Global Distribution":#FFA726, "Universal Distribution":#AB47BC, "Unknown":#9E9E9E}
